blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Labor groups are urging government agencies to release pending compensation awards for Filipino seafarers after the Supreme Court struck down a requirement that forced them to post a bond before collecting disputed monetary awards while their cases were under appeal. Former Bayan Muna Rep. Neri Colmenares, a lawyer for the Concerned Seafarers of the Philippines (CSP), said many injured seafarers had been waiting for compensation because of the provision under the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers, which took effect in October 2024.
